prompt.en: Is this for here or to go?
When did you move in?
Excuse me, is the station far from here?
prompt.zh: 不好意思，車站離這裡遠嗎？

responses.zh: 抱歉，我也是剛來這裡的。

prompt.en: Do you want a bag for that?

responses.en: No, thanks. I have my own.

prompt.en: When did your fever start?
prompt.zh: 你什麼時候開始發燒的？

responses.en: Yes, and I have a cough, too.

prompt.en: Would you like to see the dessert menu?

responses.en: I'd like a table for two.

prompt.en: How would you like to send this?
These apples are on sale today.
What size do you wear?
Why don't we meet at the station?
prompt.zh: 我們要不要在車站碰面？

prompt.en: What size would you like?
Do you need help with those boxes?

responses.en: I need a box and some tape.
responses.zh: 我需要一個箱子和一些膠帶。

prompt.en: Will that be cash or card?
Where are you going today?
Can I see your insurance card?
prompt.zh: 可以看一下您的健保卡嗎？

responses.en: I can see it from here.

prompt.en: How was everything?
Is there anything heavy inside?
How many tomatoes would you like?
Is someone helping you today?
prompt.zh: 今天有人在為您服務嗎？

responses.en: No, but I'm okay for now.

prompt.en: Would you like to join our garden team?
prompt.zh: 你想加入我們的園藝小組嗎？

responses.en: Sure. Where do I sign up?

lines.en: Hi! What can I get you?
lines.zh: 嗨！要點什麼？

lines.en: A large iced coffee, please. No sugar.
lines.zh: 一杯大杯冰咖啡，謝謝。不要加糖。

lines.en: Sorry, iced coffee only comes in small and medium.
lines.zh: 抱歉，冰咖啡只有小杯和中杯。

lines.en: Then a medium is fine. And a chocolate muffin, too.
lines.zh: 那中杯就好。再一個巧克力瑪芬。

lines.en: Sure. That's seven dollars. For here or to go?
lines.zh: 好的，一共七塊。內用還是外帶？

lines.en: For here, please.
lines.zh: 內用，謝謝。

questions.en: What size coffee does the man get?
questions.zh: 男子最後點了什麼尺寸的咖啡？

questions.en: What does the man say about his drink?
questions.zh: 男子對他的飲料有什麼要求？

lines.en: Hi. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 你好，有什麼需要嗎？

lines.en: I have a bad cold. My nose and throat hurt.
lines.zh: 我感冒得很嚴重，鼻子和喉嚨都很痛。

lines.en: Try these pills. Take one after breakfast and one after dinner.
lines.zh: 試試這個藥。早餐後吃一顆，晚餐後吃一顆。

lines.en: Will they make me sleepy? I drive to work.
lines.zh: 吃了會想睡嗎？我開車上班。

lines.en: No, they won't. But drink a lot of water and get some rest.
lines.zh: 不會。不過要多喝水，好好休息。

questions.en: How many pills should the man take each day?
What does the woman tell the man to do?

lines.en: Hello, this is the post office on Bridge Street.
lines.zh: 您好，這裡是橋街郵局。

lines.en: We have a package for you. We tried to bring it to you yesterday, but no one was home.
lines.zh: 我們有一件您的包裹。昨天我們試著送過去，但沒有人在家。

lines.en: You can pick it up at our front counter.
lines.zh: 您可以到我們的前面櫃檯領取。

lines.en: We're open from nine to five, Monday to Friday.
lines.zh: 我們的營業時間是星期一到星期五，九點到五點。

lines.en: Please bring your ID. Thank you.
lines.zh: 請帶您的身分證件。謝謝。

questions.zh: 說話者為什麼打這通電話？
options: To say a package is ready to pick up
To ask the listener to be home tomorrow
To say the post office is closed on Friday

questions.en: When can the listener pick up the package?
questions.zh: 聽者什麼時候可以去領包裹？

lines.en: Excuse me. Do you have this jacket in blue?
lines.zh: 不好意思，這件夾克有藍色的嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, only in black and green. But they're thirty percent off today.
lines.zh: 抱歉，只有黑色和綠色。不過今天打七折。

lines.en: Okay. Can I try the black one in a large?
lines.zh: 好。我可以試穿黑色的 L 號嗎？

lines.en: Sure. The fitting room is over there, next to the mirror.
lines.zh: 當然。試衣間在那邊，鏡子旁邊。

lines.en: Thanks. Oh, it fits well. I'll take it.
lines.zh: 謝謝。噢，很合身。我買這件。

questions.en: What color jacket does the man try on?
questions.zh: 男子試穿了什麼顏色的夾克？

questions.en: What does the woman say about the jackets?
questions.zh: 女子說這些夾克怎麼樣？
options: They are next to the mirror.

lines.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the hospital?
lines.zh: 不好意思，這班公車有到醫院嗎？

lines.en: No, it doesn't. You need the number seven bus.
lines.zh: 沒有喔。你要搭七號公車。

lines.en: Oh. Where does that one stop?
lines.zh: 喔，那班在哪裡停？

lines.en: On the other side of the road, in front of the bank.
lines.zh: 在馬路對面，銀行前面。

lines.en: Thanks. How often does it come?
lines.zh: 謝謝。多久來一班？

lines.en: Every twenty minutes, I think.
lines.zh: 我想是每二十分鐘一班。

questions.en: Where should the man wait for his bus?
questions.zh: 男子應該在哪裡等他要搭的公車？
options: On this side of the road

questions.en: How often does the number seven bus come?

lines.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Green Lake Park.
lines.zh: 大家早安，歡迎來到綠湖公園。

lines.en: Our clean-up event starts at ten. Please meet in front of the center.
lines.zh: 我們的清潔活動十點開始。請在活動中心前面集合。

lines.en: We have bags for everyone.
lines.zh: 每個人都有袋子可以用。

lines.en: After lunch, there is a free picnic by the lake.
lines.zh: 午餐後在湖邊有免費的野餐。

lines.en: If it rains, we will have the picnic in the center. Thanks for coming!
lines.zh: 如果下雨，野餐就改在活動中心裡舉行。謝謝大家來參加！

questions.en: What will happen if it rains?
options: The clean-up will start after lunch.
The picnic will be by the lake.
